title: Identify the precise missing activity/coercivity certificate
statement: For the present F_K catalyst clock, total exit degree is at most D_R+K. Directly dominating activity by weight(1+N)^m asks m>=D_R+K, while the available sufficient weighted path estimate needs K>=3(J+m)+b_R,J=d+4. Together these sufficient budgets would require K>=3(J+D_R+K)+b_R, which cannot close by simply increasing this clock/weight. This is a failure of this sufficient degree certificate, not a negative for sharper weights, different augmentation or the universal robust compiler. Separately, full infinite-generator weighted coercivity is not proved uniformly for cycle-truncated nominal finite volumes after edges are removed. Even conditional stationary closure still requires perturbed uniform-time transient moments and every actual firing/complete compiler cost.
